description: Topic to pattern mappings for LeetCode questions

pattern_descriptions.two-pointers: Use two pointers to traverse data structure from different positions
pattern_descriptions.sliding-window: Maintain a window of elements that slides through the data
pattern_descriptions.hash-table: Use hash table for O(1) lookups and storage
pattern_descriptions.fast-slow-pointers: Use two pointers moving at different speeds (Floyd's algorithm)
pattern_descriptions.binary-search: Divide search space in half repeatedly
pattern_descriptions.dynamic-programming: Break problem into overlapping subproblems with optimal substructure
pattern_descriptions.backtracking: Explore all possible solutions by trying and undoing choices
pattern_descriptions.monotonic-stack: Maintain stack with monotonic property (increasing or decreasing)
pattern_descriptions.heap: Priority queue for efficient min/max operations
pattern_descriptions.greedy: Make locally optimal choice at each step
pattern_descriptions.union-find: Disjoint set data structure for connectivity queries
pattern_descriptions.trie: Prefix tree for efficient string operations
pattern_descriptions.bit-manipulation: Use bitwise operations for efficient computation
pattern_descriptions.prefix-sum: Precompute cumulative sums for range queries
pattern_descriptions.binary-indexed-tree: Tree structure for efficient prefix sum updates
pattern_descriptions.segment-tree: Tree structure for range queries and updates
pattern_descriptions.topological-sort: Linear ordering of directed acyclic graph vertices
pattern_descriptions.recursion: Function calling itself to solve subproblems
pattern_descriptions.simulation: Simulate a process step by step
pattern_descriptions.rolling-hash: Hash function for sliding window on strings
pattern_descriptions.suffix-array: Sorted array of all suffixes for string operations
